sloka: धनूंषि चास्य सज्यानि हेमपृष्ठानि सर्वशः।शोभयन्ति रथश्रेष्ठं शक्रचाप इवाम्बरम् ।। ६.७१.१५ ।।
transliteration: dhanūṁṣi cāsya sajyāni hemapṛṣṭhāni sarvaśaḥ।śobhayanti rathaśreṣṭhaṁ śakracāpa ivāmbaram ।। 6.71.15 ।।

translations.english: "His bows decorated with gold on the back, are like a rainbow in the sky on all sides and makes the chariot excellent."
